assumption: The storage of the structure fields before the reset is performed via reset-safe RAM or non-volatile memory.
rationale: SWS_Dcm_00988 and SWS_Dcm_00543 define saving relevant information before the jump to the bootloader, but do not specify the concrete physical storage medium.
